text:
maria: quick review request  compact axis header + responsive unit pill + legend behavior on narrow panels. thinking: single-line y label, right-aligned pill that can collapse to icon on narrow widths, legend limited to 2 rows with explicit expand. feedback? :eyes:

jake: can you drop the mobile breakpoint screenshots? curious how pill collapses when legend wraps twice

maria: added links: desktop/mobile prototypes in figma (link pasted). screenshot for narrow panel attached.

olivia: general +1. accessibility: when pill collapses to icon, ensure it still exposes the full text via aria-label and a visible focus state. also tooltip on hover for mouse users.

samir: about smoothing control: if it's only relevant per-series, consider an inline micro-toggle inside the legend row for that series; otherwise keep it in toolbar but ensure logical tab order.

maria: proposal: pill shows full copy "Units: USD" or "Units: requests" on desktop; at <420px becomes icon with aria-label and tooltip. legend: maxLines 2, show "+ more" if exceeded. smoothing: toolbar-level toggle for global smoothing, per-series inline toggle for single-series charts. snippet (informational only):
```json
{ "yAxis.labelMaxLines": 1, "yAxis.unitPill": "auto", "legend.maxLines": 2, "legend.moreText": "+ more", "toolbar.items": ["export","smoothingToggle"] }
```

jake: copy nit: prefer explicit prefix "Units:" in pill copy. safer for shared dashboards. also export PNGs need to include pill text not icon-only fallback.

olivia: keyboard flow: if inline per-series toggles exist, they must be focusable and reachable by arrow keys when legend is focused. document this in acceptance tests.

samir: outlier treatment: propose hybrid: auto-detect spikes > 10x median -> place flagged marker with a tiny chevron to reveal options: annotate only vs cap values. default to annotate. microcopy for marker tooltip: "Spike: 12.3M. Options: annotate | cap"

jake: don't rely on color for the marker. use a small outlined diamond + pattern stroke for the capped visualization mode. include screenreader-friendly announcement: "Spike detected at 12.3 million" when focus lands on marker.

maria: action items: 1) implement pill collapse behavior + aria-label + tooltip, 2) explicit "Units:" copy variants for A/B, 3) per-series smoothing micro-toggle for single-series + toolbar global toggle for multi-series, 4) outlier flag with options and non-color indicator, 5) ensure PNG export contains visible pill text, 6) add keyboard/VO acceptance criteria.

designbot: created issue #4011: "responsive unit pill, legend collapse, smoothing placement, outlier flags" assigned to @maria and @samir.

samir: i'll prototype marker + per-series toggle this afternoon and ping for review. :thumbsup:

jake: i'll add the export checklist item so analytics docs team gets notified.

maria: thanks all  uploading updated prototypes soon, closing thread after quick pass. :sparkles:
